text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0855 CDT.

CANOLA - $0.80 to $1.00 higher on expected higher CBOT U.S. soybean futures and ideas Tuesday's declines were overdone should prompt buying. Canada's dollar was weaker at C$1.3797 versus the U.S. dollar.
FLAXSEED - $1.00 higher. Market called oversold Tuesday and should partially recover Wednesday. However, outlook was lower because of light demand and bearish chart trends.
WESTERN BARLEY - steady-$0.50 higher. Tuesday's declines called excessive and recovery expected.
FEED WHEAT - steady-$0.50 higher. Traders expect recovery from Tuesday's declines, but said hedge selling may limit gains.
PEAS - steady-$0.50 higher. Expected higher CBOT soymeal futures.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
